findings: Both Bar and depth event-page integration tests call assert_report_projection_parity, which exercises JSON, HTML, XLSX, and benchmark CSV projections from the same report analysis.
The shared parity helper checks exact timestamp-aligned period facts in JSON, HTML, XLSX Benchmark worksheet, and CSV; CSV rows retain run identity and period fields.
The fixture verifies Bar same-timestamp equity collapse and depth analysis from the replay-verified complete curve, independent of bounded presentation preview.
The separate report_cli_projects_one_verified_benchmark_analysis_to_json_html_xlsx_and_csv integration test verifies the standalone CLI report path and is present in the R17 required evidence set.
The six focused Rust metric/report contract checks also pass on the Windows host; Linux and macOS CI now run the same helper for platform evidence.
limitations: This review includes Windows local acceptance only. The corresponding Linux/macOS CI runs are configured but have not yet produced evidence.
No claim is made about production data licensing or live venue readiness.
